latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Copywriter Video — generate persuasive scripts and captions automatically for your video uploads.

- Upload raw video footage (up to 500MB); receive script-overlaid, ready-to-post 1080p MP4s within about a minute.
- No manual editing required: simply describe your goal (e.g., "write and overlay a sales script as captions for my product video") and let the system handle copywriting and captioning.
- Integrated backend authentication, session management, and robust error handling.
- Supports major video/audio/image formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, MP3, PNG, and more).
- Automatic free credit system for unregistered users; upgrade/register for higher export tiers.
- Built for marketers seeking fast, persuasive AI-generated copy without extra hiring or editing tools.
